**Result: compliant (preferred position).**

Client carries no exclusivity or sole-supplier commitment: the licence is non-exclusive and Section 2(a) affirmatively preserves our freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services. The credit-report ordering step in Section 3(i) is conditional on our voluntary use of the Interface and so does not amount to exclusive dealing, and Section 8(d)'s non-exclusive licence runs from us to TrueLink (relevant to IP, not this rule). No redline proposed.
